content:
The public presentation of DIGITALbuilt, the Portuguese Digital Hub created to support the digital transition in the AEC, Rail and Mineral Resources sectors, will take place on 30 April, and will provide SMEs with digital transformation services, capacity building, digital inclusion, support in seeking financing and intermediation, SME incubation services and digital maturity assessments.

📅 Date: 30 April 2024

🕝 Time: 2:30pm

🏢 Location: Ordem dos Engenheiros - Região Sul – Lisbon

Attendance is free of charge, but registration is mandatory at https://tinyurl.com/5yz52p54

DIGITALbuilt is a collaborative initiative of the AEC Cluster, the Rail Cluster (Plataforma Ferroviária Portuguesa), ACPMR – Associação Cluster Portugal Mineral Resources, the Itecons Interface Centre, the Rail Competences Centre, StoneCITI, BUILT CoLAB, INESC TEC, FI GROUP and FNWAY, which has been recognised as a Digital Innovation Hub in Portugal and as a European Digital Innovation Hub. With the implementation of this project, SMEs will now have this Hub available to become more innovative, sustainable and efficient.
